title: A Snowsports School Product That Carries a Makeup Date, and What Is Made Good on It
content:
A Snowsports School product that carries a makeup allowance works the amount made good out differently from one that carries none, because a date the participant may still take answers for part of what was lost.

**Clause 1 — the makeup period and how it is counted.** The makeup period is counted in calendar days from the day the request raised over the lost session was registered, the day of registration counting as day zero, every day of the week counting alike. Where no request raised over a lost session stands against the booking, the handling date is taken to fall outside that makeup period.

**Clause 2 — a product that carries a makeup allowance, inside the period.** Where the product allows a makeup session and the handling date falls inside that makeup period, the amount made good is the session value taken at the weather share and then halved, the balance being answered by the makeup date still open to the participant.

**Clause 3 — a product that carries a makeup allowance, outside the period.** Where the product allows a makeup session and the handling date falls outside that makeup period, the amount made good is the whole session value, the weather share not being applied to it at all.

**Clause 4 — a product that carries no makeup allowance.** Where the product allows no makeup session, the amount made good is the session value taken at the weather share.

## The allowances and periods the clauses turn on

| Product | Makeup sessions allowed | Makeup period (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 0 | 0 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 0 | 0 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 0 | 0 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 2 | 21 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 0 | 0 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 0 | 0 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 1 | 14 |

A product whose allowance stands at 0 sessions allows no makeup session, and clause 4 governs it. A product whose allowance stands at 1 or 2 sessions allows one, and clauses 2 and 3 divide between them on the date.

## Input, judgement, outcome

- **Input.** A booking of the Elite Performance Camp, whose allowance is 1 session and whose makeup period is 14 calendar days; a request raised over a lost session registered on the second of a month; a handling date of the tenth of that month; a session value of 460.00 USD and a weather share of 80 percent.
- **Judgement.** Counting the second as day zero, the tenth is day eight, which falls inside the 14-day makeup period, so clause 2 governs.
- **Outcome.** The session value taken at 80 percent is 368.00 USD, and halved it is 184.00 USD.

Take the same booking with a handling date of the twentieth. That is day eighteen, outside the 14-day period, so clause 3 governs and the whole 460.00 USD is made good. Take instead a booking of the Semi-Private Coaching Session, whose allowance stands at 0: clause 4 governs, and the amount made good is 460.00 USD taken at 80 percent, which is 368.00 USD.

Where no request raised over a lost session stands against a booking of a product that carries an allowance, clause 1 puts the handling date outside the period and clause 3 governs.
